title: Can Claude replace BambooHR? 20/20 checks, 44 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a BambooHR alternative, an employee onboarding checklist where every task has one owner and a due date set from the start date, from one written spec: all 20 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 44 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:47): https://youtu.be/sdlGQ1rFUlk
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/employee-onboarding
BambooHR pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/bamboohr

BambooHR prices: for 25 employees or fewer, a flat $250 a month for Core ($425 Pro, $650 Elite); above 25, from $10.25 per employee per month for Core (bamboohr.com/pricing, October 2026). Onboarding is one part of its HR system.

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
